role.title: OT Vulnerability Assessor
role.description: STUB. Assesses OT systems for vulnerabilities and tests security controls (including penetration testing where it is safe) without disrupting production or safety.
role.overlaps_method: Computed: NICE roles sharing the most statements with this role, excluding the roles it extends.
